---
The letter-to-sound rules folded into ecouter.js, ecouter-speech.js
and viriditas.js are those of NRL Report 7948 (1976), as kept in C by John A.
Wasser in 1985, who placed them in the public domain. They are reproduced here
as public domain. The formant throat follows a published paper (Klatt, 1980);
no code from any other synthesizer is included.
